items.name: AL Safa 1&2
Academic city
items.description:
The Dubai authorities have been implementing an ambitious project called "Dubai Academic City" for more than ten years. It provides for the creation of a world training center, which will become one of the largest on the planet. The area of the Dubai Academic City district should cover more than " it is planned to be placed on an area of several tens of millions of square meters.

The first stage of the project, called "Knowledge Village", is almost completely completed today. It was attended by over 30 universities from different countries, which opened their branches in Dubai. The second stage provides for the creation of an extensive infrastructure. The development of the Dubai Academic City district is a combination of buildings of different heights that are intended for residential or commercial purposes. Educational and sports centers, offices, administrative buildings, shops, cafes and restaurants are located here.

items.name: Al Aweer
items.description:
Al Aweer in Sharjah is a unique blend of industrial and residential areas that create a distinctive atmosphere in the neighbourhood. The neighbourhood is known for its variety of businesses and residential offerings, making it attractive to different types of residents.
 The industrial area of Al Aweer offers a variety of business opportunities including warehouses, workshops, machine shops, manufacturing space and other businesses. Industries ranging from building materials to the automotive industry are concentrated here, making it an important economic hub in Sharjah.
 The Al Aweer residential area offers residents a variety of housing options including apartments, villas and townhouses. The neighbourhood is characterised by a tranquil environment surrounded by green spaces and parks, creating a comfortable living environment.
 The infrastructure of the area is well developed: there are schools, kindergartens, medical centres, supermarkets, restaurants and other service facilities.
The neighbourhood also has good transport accessibility, providing easy access both within the neighbourhood and to other parts of Sharjah.

items.name: Al Barari
items.description:
Al Barari is a unique and exclusive residential neighborhood that is known for its luxury, beauty and green oases amidst the desert. Located in the heart of the Dubai Natural Zone, Al Barari offers its residents privacy and luxury amidst abundant vegetation and nature.
 Residential properties in the area are of the highest quality of construction and design, offering residences in a contemporary and luxurious style. Villas, apartments and townhouses can be found here, equipped with the latest amenities and innovations.
 One of the features of Al Barari is environmental protection and sustainable use of resources. The area actively cooperates with organizations that promote environmental responsibility and offers its residents exclusive gardens, parks, lakes and rainforests.
 Residents of the neighborhood can enjoy a variety of amenities and activities including fine dining restaurants, spas, gyms, walking trails, community pools and more. This neighborhood is ideal for those who appreciate comfort, luxury, and being one with nature.
 Al Barari also impresses with its architectural style inspired by nature and local traditions, which creates a unique atmosphere of luxury and harmony. The neighborhood is an ideal place for those seeking privacy surrounded by nature without sacrificing luxury and comfort.

items.name: Al Barsha First
items.description: Al Barsha First is a vibrant residential community in the heart of Dubai, known for its central location, family-friendly atmosphere, and convenient connectivity. Situated near Sheikh Zayed Road and Mall of the Emirates, it offers easy access to major business and leisure hubs across the city. The area features a mix of modern apartments, spacious villas, and serviced residences surrounded by schools, supermarkets, cafes, and healthcare facilities. With its blend of urban comfort and suburban peace, Al Barsha First is a preferred choice for families and professionals seeking a well-connected yet relaxed lifestyle in Dubai.

items.name: Al Barsha Second
items.description: Al Barsha Second is a well-established residential community in Dubai, offering a perfect balance of convenience and comfort. Located close to Sheikh Zayed Road and neighboring Al Barsha First, the area provides easy access to major landmarks such as Mall of the Emirates, Dubai Internet City, and Dubai Media City. The community features a mix of modern apartments, townhouses, and villas, complemented by essential amenities including schools, supermarkets, clinics, and recreational facilities. Known for its peaceful streets and family-friendly environment, Al Barsha Second is ideal for residents seeking a vibrant urban lifestyle with a touch of suburban tranquility.

items.name: Al Barsha South 1
items.description: Al Barsha South 1 is a modern residential community in Dubai, designed for families and professionals seeking a peaceful yet well-connected lifestyle. Situated close to Sheikh Zayed Road and within easy reach of Dubai Marina, Mall of the Emirates, and key business hubs, it offers excellent connectivity across the city. The area features a mix of spacious villas, townhouses, and low-rise apartments, complemented by schools, supermarkets, healthcare facilities, and leisure options. With its calm streets, green spaces, and family-friendly environment, Al Barsha South 1 provides a balanced lifestyle combining urban convenience with suburban tranquility.

items.name: Al Barsha South 2
items.description: Al Barsha South 2 is a contemporary residential community in Dubai, offering a serene and family-friendly environment with excellent connectivity to the rest of the city. Located near Sheikh Zayed Road, it provides easy access to key destinations like Dubai Marina, Mall of the Emirates, and Dubai Internet City. The community features a mix of villas, townhouses, and low-rise apartments, complemented by essential amenities such as schools, supermarkets, healthcare centers, and recreational facilities. Known for its quiet streets, landscaped surroundings, and modern infrastructure, Al Barsha South 2 is an ideal choice for families and professionals seeking a balanced lifestyle in a well-planned neighborhood.

items.name: Al Barsha Third
items.description: Al Barsha Third is a well-planned residential community in Dubai, offering a peaceful and family-friendly environment with easy access to the city’s major hubs. Strategically located near Sheikh Zayed Road, residents enjoy convenient connectivity to Mall of the Emirates, Dubai Internet City, and Dubai Marina. The area features a mix of modern apartments, townhouses, and villas, alongside schools, supermarkets, healthcare facilities, and recreational spaces. With its quiet streets, green surroundings, and modern amenities, Al Barsha Third is ideal for families and professionals looking for a balanced lifestyle that combines suburban tranquility with urban accessibility.

items.name: Al Furjan
items.description: Al Furjan is one of the most popular and rapidly evolving locations in Dubai, UAE. Situated in a strategic, central location of the city, this well-planned master development, comprises of gated villa and townhouse communities, and attractive low-rise apartment buildings, all blended seamlessly to create an ideal location for both families, young urban professionals, and holiday makers. Within the surrounding districts of Al Furjan are several schools and Kindergartens, medical institutions, as well as malls and leisure destinations, which are all within easy reach.  A great advantage that Al Furjan has is that it is directly along the Metro line which provides easy connectivity to all key areas of Dubai, including, Expo City, Al Maktoum Airport, Ain Dubai and Bluewaters, JBR Beachfront, as well direct commutes to the Downtown and DIFC Districts. A well-designed road system makes commuting for residents much easier, with links to all the major highways and very little traffic congestion. When considering locations to either invest in property or to live, Al Furjan is regarded as the ideal locality, as it offers a wide range of real estate options at very affordable sale prices, competitive rental rates, and significant capital appreciation of your property.

items.name: Al Garhoud
items.description:
Al Garhoud — the area, better known by the abbreviated name Garhoud (Garhoud), is a thoughtful mix of residential and commercial real estate. Located on the border of the "two worlds", old and new Dubai, the area has absorbed the best of them. The most popular and oldest hotels in Dubai, such as Al Bustan Rotana, Le Méridien Dubai, Millennium Airport Hotel, are adjacent here to newer islands of hospitality, like Jumeirah Creekside Hotel.
After crossing the Garhoud Bridge, connecting two emirates — Dubai and Sharjah — you immediately get to this old, but quite cozy area of Dubai, located between the central shopping and entertainment complex of Deira Deira City Centre and Dubai Festival City. To improve the transport situation, the Dubai authorities have created two additional interchanges here in the direction from the Bur Dubai area to Deira and from the Al Garhoud area (the Business Bay interchange and the Floating Bridge pontoon Bridge). Just a few kilometers separating this area from Dubai International Airport give an important advantage in terms of investment in housing with the possibility of further profitable rental. It also has its own GGICO metro station, and a well-developed bus network makes it easy to get to the areas of Jebel Ali, Bur Dubai, Deira and Mirdif.
As in any old part of the city, there is always something to do in the Garhoud area thanks to the abundance of various leisure, sports and entertainment facilities. And first on this list is the main attraction in Garhoud — Dubai Tennis Stadium, where open tennis championships are held from February to March, and in parallel with them and at other times — also a lot of different events, concerts, etc.
You can also find entertainment to your liking in two huge shopping complexes located next door — Deira City Centre and Dubai Festival City, with all their possibilities from shopping to cinema, as well as in any of the hotel clubs. Excellent food, music and atmosphere are always waiting for visitors in another iconic place of the area — The Irish Village pub, famous throughout Dubai. You can work out in the gym, swim in the pool and visit the spa at The Aviation Club complex. Educational institutions in the district are represented by a mass of schools with a well-deserved reputation, such as Cambridge International School, Al Mawakeb School or Grammar School.
real estate
Hotel apartments, suites, apartments or villas — the choice of real estate for sale in the Garhoud area is quite wide. Belonging to an older housing stock makes local housing quite attractive from a certain side, because this means more spacious premises compared to New Dubai and often better layout of apartments and villas.

items.name: Al Hudaiba
items.description: Al Hudaiba is a district in Dubai, United Arab Emirates. The small village of Al-Khudaiba is located near Port Rashid. Important sights of Al Hudaiba are the Chelsea Hotel and the Consulate of Sri Lanka. The area borders the cities of Al Mina, Port Rashid, Al Jafilia and Al Bada.

items.name: Al Jaddaf
items.description:
Al Jaddaf is a unique neighbourhood in Dubai that is located on the banks of the Dubai Canal and is a mix of modern buildings, historical landmarks and luxury hotels. The area is strategically located, close to the city centre and has easy access to major thoroughfares.
 Al Jaddaf is renowned for its luxury properties, which include high-rise residential buildings, modern hotels, shopping malls and entertainment complexes. Housing options range from luxury apartments with stunning views to stylish townhouses.
 With its modern design and cosy ambience, Al Jaddaf attracts both locals and tourists looking to enjoy a luxurious lifestyle in the heart of Dubai. The area is also known for its upscale restaurants, cafes and shops that create a cosy atmosphere for relaxing and shopping.
Al Jaddaf also has a rich cultural heritage embodied in historic buildings and monuments such as the Dubai Cultural Historic District, museums and archaeological sites. This makes the neighbourhood attractive to history and culture lovers who want to learn more about the rich history of ancient and modern Dubai.

items.name: Al Jaffiliya
items.description: Al Jafiliya, also spelled Jafiliya, is a community in Dubai, United Arab Emirates, primarily made up of private residences, but also including the Dubai Naturalization and Residence Department, the Rydges Plaza Hotel, and the Al Hana Center shopping mall.

items.name: Al Karama
items.description: Al Karama is one of Dubai’s most vibrant and centrally located residential neighborhoods, known for its lively streets, diverse community, and affordable living options. Situated close to Downtown Dubai, Bur Dubai, and Sheikh Zayed Road, it offers excellent connectivity to major business, shopping, and entertainment hubs. The area features a mix of mid-rise apartments, retail outlets, and local markets, complemented by schools, mosques, healthcare centers, and dining options. Renowned for its multicultural atmosphere, walkable streets, and bustling markets, Al Karama appeals to residents seeking an energetic urban lifestyle with convenience and accessibility at its core.

items.name: Al Khawaneej 1
items.description:
Al Khawaneej This is also an area of Dubai which is divided into two distinct parts including farms and a residential area. They are as follows: Al Khawaneej 1 and Al Khawaneej 2.

This is the only area in the emirate of Dubai that has about 100 percent of local nationalities living in two areas. It is located near Mushrif Park, which is a desert park in Dubai and is located in the eastern part of the city.

It's more than a 15 minute drive from one of the newest and largest malls in Dubai, Mirjif City Centre.

items.name: Al Khawaneej 2
items.description:
Al Khawaneej is a farming as well as residential community. The suburban neighbourhood has two districts, Al Khawaneej 1 and Al Khawaneej 2. The parent community is close to areas such as International City, Al Warqaa and Mirdif. The entire area is mainly populated by natives, thus the community has a traditional feel to it. 

Al Khawaneej 2 primarily is a rural area and consists of many private farms and other agricultural lands. Most people residing here run agricultural businesses. Places for leisure in the surrounding areas are:

A significant area of Al Khawaneej 2 is occupied by agricultural lands, nurseries, farms and stables for camel and horses. It has two popular companies, Al Rawabi Dairy Company and National Agricultural Development Company that are the leading manufacturers and distributors of dairy

items.name: Al Kifaf
items.description:
Al Kifaf is a neighborhood located in the heart of the city and is a mix of residential and commercial properties, including high-rise buildings and small villas.
 This area is famous for its convenient location - it is close to the city's business center, shopping malls, restaurants, parks and beaches. There are also various educational institutions, banks, medical centers and supermarkets, which makes the life of residents comfortable and convenient.
 Some of the main attractions of the neighborhood are the large picturesque Zabeel Park and the famous Dubai Frame, a tall structure that is a huge rectangle-shaped frame that frames a panoramic view of the old and new city of Dubai.
 Al Kifaf also has a well-developed infrastructure - roads, public transportation, and parking lots. Residents of the neighborhood have access to a variety of services and entertainment, making it an attractive place to live for both locals and international visitors.
 The overall atmosphere in Al Kifaf neighborhood is calm and prosperous, making it an attractive choice for families with children as well as young professionals and tourists. The combination of convenient location, developed infrastructure and diverse opportunities makes Al Kifaf an attractive neighborhood for living and recreation in Dubai.

items.name: Al Mamzar
items.description: Al Mamzar is one of Dubai’s most scenic and family-friendly coastal neighborhoods, offering a harmonious blend of seaside tranquility and urban convenience. Nestled along the Dubai–Sharjah border, this waterfront community is known for its lush green parks, pristine beaches, and calm residential atmosphere — making it an ideal choice for families and those seeking a relaxed lifestyle away from the city’s hustle.

items.name: Al Manara
items.description: Al Manara is a developing community offering various residential and commercial villas for rent and for sale. The chic area is located no more than 13 minutes from Jumeirah Beach. As for the property, there are no apartments or townhouses in this area, and it is usually preferred by families. Al Manara, an Arabic word meaning "lighthouse", is an exquisitely built residential complex in western Dubai. Al-Manara has a favorable location, its neighbors are Al-Safa in the east, Umm Sukeim in the north and Umm al-Sheif in the west. The area also runs along the huge Sheikh Zayed Highway, which connects Dubai's leading entertainment and commercial centers.

items.name: Al Mankhool
items.description: Al Mankhool is a well-established residential and commercial neighborhood in Bur Dubai, known for its strategic location, vibrant community, and convenient lifestyle. Situated close to Al Karama, Downtown Dubai, and major transport links, it offers easy access to business districts, shopping centers, and cultural attractions. The area features a mix of mid-rise apartments, offices, and retail spaces, alongside schools, clinics, and local eateries. With its lively streets, accessible amenities, and multicultural environment, Al Mankhool is popular among families, professionals, and expatriates seeking a well-connected urban lifestyle in the heart of Dubai.

items.name: Al Mizhar 1
items.description: Mizhar is an Arabic word which means 'blossom'. The community has over the years seen a rise in popularity. The privacy and large size of the villas paired with low rental rates are key factors. The community mostly consists of villas that come in 3, 4 and 5-bedroom configurations. This suburb within Dubai is perfect for large families due to the size of the homes in Al Mizhar. Overall, the community has a family-friendly vibe due to its proximity to parks, malls and schools.

items.name: Al Mizhar 2
items.description: An outskirts area in Dubai, the community of Al Mizhar lies to the east of Deira. It is a part of the northern region known as the older side of Dubai which retains its traditional charm. One of its two precincts is Al Mizhar 2. It is smaller of the two sub-communities and occupies the eastern part of the suburb. While including most of the daily-need conveniences, Al Mizhar 2 has proximity to a number of key amenities such as the airport, malls, main highway, leisure areas and public transportation.

items.name: Al Nahda
items.description: Al Nahda 1 is a mixed-use development set on the Dubai-Sharjah border. It is a sub-community of Al Nahda Dubai, featuring affordable accommodation options and an abundance of communal facilities and amenities. Besides residential and commercial buildings, the family-friendly neighbourhood is home to the oldest shopping mall – Al Mulla Plaza and Rashid Stadium. The city’s primary thoroughfare – Al Ittihad Road, runs along with the community connecting it to the central areas of the emirate in a short drive.

items.name: Al Qusais 1
items.description:
Al Qusais is one of the oldest and culturally rich areas of Dubai. The area is split into two main clusters – Al Qusais Residential Area and Al Qusais Industrial Area. The residential area is categorised into three zones: Al Qusais 1, Al Qusais 2 and Al Qusais 3.

Al Qusais 1 is a sub-community of Al Qusais. This mixed-use community is home to numerous commercial and residential properties. One can find primary and recreational facilities such as hospitals, supermarkets, mosques, schools, hotels and restaurants at short intervals.

items.name: Al Qusais 2
items.description: Al Qusais 2 is a well-established residential and industrial community in Dubai, offering a blend of convenience, accessibility, and urban living. Located near Dubai International Airport and Sheikh Mohammed Bin Zayed Road, the area provides easy connectivity to key business and leisure hubs across the city. The community features a mix of apartments, villas, and commercial properties, complemented by schools, supermarkets, healthcare centers, and retail outlets. Known for its family-friendly environment, practical amenities, and proximity to major transport routes, Al Qusais 2 is a preferred choice for residents and businesses seeking a balanced lifestyle in one of Dubai’s dynamic neighborhoods.

items.name: Al Qusais Industrial Area 1
items.description: Al Qusais Industrial Area 1 is a mixed-use development to the south of Al Qusais. As the name suggests, it is one of the sub-districts in Al Qusais Industrial Area. Bin Shabib Mall is the highlight of this area with a hypermarket, restaurants and many retail stores. Most importantly, the neighbourhood is close to the major thoroughfares and notable landmarks in Dubai.

items.name: Al Qusais Industrial Area 3
items.description: Al Qusais Industrial Area 3 is a sub-community of Al Qusais. It is close to the Dubai – Sharjah border. The mixed-use development offers well-structured residential, commercial and industrial properties for an affordable price range. Commercial properties that are available include offices, shops and warehouses. It is sandwiched between Sharjah Ring Road, Damascus Street, Amman Street and Al Nahda Street.

items.name: Al Qusais Industrial Area 4
items.description: Al Qusais Industrial Area 4 is a key commercial and industrial hub in Dubai, strategically located near Dubai International Airport and Sheikh Mohammed Bin Zayed Road, offering seamless connectivity to the city’s major business districts. The area primarily consists of warehouses, workshops, showrooms, and office spaces, catering to industries such as logistics, manufacturing, and trading. Despite its industrial focus, it is supported by essential amenities including cafes, retail outlets, and limited residential facilities for staff. Known for its functional infrastructure, central location, and accessibility, Al Qusais Industrial Area 4 is an ideal base for businesses looking for efficiency and connectivity in Dubai’s thriving commercial landscape.

items.name: Al Qusais Industrial Area 5
items.description: Al Qusais Industrial Area 5 is a sub-community of Al Qusais. It is located right next to the Dubai – Sharjah Border and is a popular mixed-use development. The neighbourhood offers affordable residential and industrial properties including apartments, offices, shops and warehouses. It is sandwiched between Sheikh Mohammed Bin Zayed Road, Sharjah Ring Road, Beirut Street and Amman Street.

items.name: Al Raffa
items.description: Al Raffa is a quiet, modest residential area with shopping malls, including the Al Khaleej Center complex, famous for its electronics stores, and a large Baqer Mohebi supermarket. The New Gold Souk Center's jewelry stores sell gold and diamond jewelry at wholesale prices. There are budget hotels in the area, next to which are traditional Arabic cafes and simple South Asian restaurants. Cruise ships depart from nearby Port Rashid

items.name: Al Rashidiya
items.description:
South of Dubai International Airport is the Al Rashidiya area of Dubai. The area is commonly known as Rashidiya. Here residents will find several government offices, malls and other attractions. Al Rashidiya has mostly villas, making it suitable for families looking for a home in the heart of old Dubai.
Al Rashidiya, Dubai is also located close to many transport hubs. With a metro station and several bus routes, Rashidiya is undoubtedly one of the best residential areas in Dubai for non-drivers. The area is located along Airport Road (D89) and Sheikh Mohammed bin Zayed Highways (E311) and Nad al-Hamar Street (D62). In addition, bus routes operating from several points in the area connect residents to key areas, including Silicon Oasis and Al Awir.

items.name: Al Safouh First
items.description:
Al Sufouh neighbourhood is a beautiful residential community in Dubai, located along the Gulf Coast. This neighbourhood perfectly combines luxury, comfort and convenience, making it one of the attractive places to live in the city.
 Al Sufouh offers a variety of housing options including elegant skyscrapers, luxury villas and stylish apartments. Due to its location in close proximity to the beach, residents of the neighbourhood can enjoy a tranquil atmosphere and beautiful beach views.
 Al Sufouh also has extensive infrastructure for comfortable living, including schools, supermarkets, restaurants and entertainment centres. The neighbourhood is also great for those who appreciate an active lifestyle, as there are plenty of opportunities for water sports or promenade walks.
 In addition, the neighbourhood is in a convenient location that provides easy access to the city's main road arteries, making getting around the city more convenient and faster.
 Al Sufouh is an attractive neighbourhood for those looking for luxurious and comfortable accommodation in Dubai, with close access to the beach and convenient infrastructure for everyday living.

items.name: Al Safouh Second
items.description:
Dubai Media City (DMC) is a prestigious business district in the heart of Dubai and is one of the largest media centers in the region. It is home to the offices of many local and international companies operating in the media industry, as well as various retail outlets and commercial facilities.
 DMC is a free economic zone that has a developed infrastructure specifically designed for companies related to the media business. The area is ideal for those who want to immerse themselves in the media environment and interact with industry professionals.
 All the advantages of DMC are not only due to its business importance but also due to its convenient location. The area is in the heart of Dubai's residential and commercial districts, providing easy access to various infrastructure, convenient transportation links and a variety of leisure options. In addition, there are many luxury hotels, restaurants and other facilities for quality leisure and work.

items.name: Al Satwa
items.description:
Al Satwa is a small neighborhood in Dubai, located in the vicinity of Trade Centre, City Walk, Al Bada and Jumeirah. One of the main highways of the city, Sheikh Zayed Road, passes nearby.
 There are many shopping and entertainment venues in the area which creates a very lively atmosphere, but at the same time Al Satwa is a very family friendly neighborhood, ideal for a quiet and happy life with children.
 The area is home to numerous retail outlets with a wide variety of goods, including supermarkets, clothing boutiques, ateliers, jewelry stores, building materials, furniture and interior design stores, pet stores, and pharmacies. Along Al Hudaiba Street, which goes by the name "Flower Street", there are flower stores with live and artificial plants. To maintain a healthy lifestyle, the neighborhood has several gyms, spas and wellness services. Also in Al Satwa there are many schools, and in the neighboring areas there are prestigious universities.
 The main types of real estate - apartments and villas. Complexes with residences with 1-3 bedrooms and studios are ready for occupancy, and investors can get a profit of 4% per year from the rental of real estate in short or long term rentals.

items.name: Al Twar 1
items.description: Al Twar 1 is a locality in the emirate of Dubai and a sub-community of Al Twar. It is considered an expensive residential district and is home to many Dubai businessmen. It is mainly a residential neighbourhood and is accessible via Al Nahda Street and Al Quds Street. The locality is within walking distance to Al Nahda Metro Station, Dubai International Airport, Al Bustan Centre & Residence, business outlets, retail shops and many other amenities.

items.name: Al Twar 2
items.description: Al Twar 2 is a residential community located close to the Dubai-Sharjah border. The area is positioned towards the eastern region of Dubai. The locality boasts a family-friendly ambience with an array of facilities within the vicinity.

items.name: Al Twar 3
items.description: Al Twar 3 is a well-established residential community in Dubai, offering a peaceful and family-friendly environment while maintaining excellent connectivity to the city’s main hubs. Located near Al Nahda, Sheikh Mohammed Bin Zayed Road, and Dubai International Airport, the area provides easy access to business districts, shopping centers, and entertainment destinations. Al Twar 3 features a mix of apartments, townhouses, and villas, along with essential amenities such as schools, supermarkets, clinics, and parks. Known for its quiet streets, green spaces, and community-oriented lifestyle, Al Twar 3 is an ideal choice for families and professionals seeking a comfortable and well-connected neighborhood in Dubai.

items.name: Al Warqa
items.description:
Al Warqaa is a rapidly developing area. With newly built residential properties, including villas and apartments, Al Warqaa is positioned as an affordable area for renting and buying property. It is home to a number of prominent schools, the Warqa mall, restaurants and a range of other amenities, making it a full-fledged residential suburb.
Named after the popular dove-like bird ("warqaa" in Arabic), Al-Warqaa, the main community is divided into five subdistricts, numbered 1 to 5. Al-Warqaa subgroups 1, 2, 3 and 4 are mostly residential, and Al Warqaa 5 consists of various elements that make up the Dubai Safari Park. Dubai Safari, built at Al Warqa 5 on Aweer Road on an area of 400 hectares, includes a safari park, a butterfly park, golf courses, entertainment and recreational areas. The Dubai safari replaces the ailing Dubai Zoo. 2500 animals of about 250 species were relocated to the new place.

items.name: Al Wasl
items.description:
Al Wasl is a prestigious and picturesque neighbourhood in Dubai, which is one of the most attractive places to live and relax. Al Wasl is located in the centre of the city and is renowned for its variety of accommodation, dining, shopping and entertainment options.
 One of Al Wasl's main attractions is the famous Al Wasl Road, which winds through the area, providing easy access to the city's main shopping and entertainment centres. Al Wasl Road is home to many luxury villas, apartments and townhouses offering a high level of comfort and convenience to residents.
 The neighbourhood is known for its green parks and squares where residents can enjoy walks, picnics and sporting events. There are also many restaurants of different cuisines, cafes, coffee shops and shops present here, creating a unique atmosphere for foodies and shopping connoisseurs.
 Al Wasl is also known for its close proximity to key Dubai attractions such as the Dubai Canal and Jumeirah Beach. This makes the neighbourhood ideal for those who want to enjoy proximity to the sea and the city's entertainment.

items.name: Al Yelayiss 1
items.description:
Al Yelayiss 1 is a fast-developing residential community located near Dubai Investment Park and Jebel Ali. It offers a calm suburban atmosphere while staying well-connected to major highways like Sheikh Mohammed Bin Zayed Road and Emirates Road, ensuring smooth access to the rest of Dubai.

The area features a mix of villas, townhouses, and low-rise homes, making it ideal for families looking for more space and privacy. Many residences are designed with modern layouts, landscaped gardens, and open terraces — reflecting a balance between comfort and contemporary style.

items.name: Al Yufrah 1
items.description:
Al Yufrah 1 is a thoughtfully planned residential community located along the Dubai–Al Ain Road, offering a serene escape from the city’s hustle while maintaining strong connectivity to Dubai’s key hubs. Designed with families and long-term residents in mind, this community focuses on low-rise villas and townhouses, surrounded by landscaped open spaces, walking trails, and leisure zones.

The development features 3- to 5-bedroom homes with private gardens, spacious interiors, and contemporary design. Sub-communities such as Alana at The Valley further enhance the area’s appeal by providing resort-style amenities and green spaces that encourage a balanced and healthy lifestyle. Every element of Al Yufrah 1 is geared toward creating a welcoming, family-oriented neighborhood where community living meets privacy.

Residents enjoy easy access to major road networks like Sheikh Mohammed Bin Zayed Road, making Downtown Dubai, Dubai Marina, and other key destinations reachable within a reasonable drive. The community is also close to leisure attractions and shopping hubs, providing a mix of convenience and tranquility.

items.name: Arabian Ranches 1
items.description: Wadi Al Safa 6 is a popular residential community located in Dubai. A variety of residential complexes of different types and sizes can be found here, designed for the comfortable living of its residents. The neighbourhood has both residential apartments and villas equipped with modern amenities. Surrounded by residential buildings that create a unique view of the Dubai skyline. Surrounded by parks, the villas and apartments enjoy magnificent views from the windows, making the area an ideal holiday destination. Staying in a luxury residential neighbourhood is appreciated for its mesmerising views, clean environment and upscale amenities. The sought-after housing options are perfect for professionals and families alike. Shops, mosques, cafes, hotels and restaurants are located near the neighbourhood, providing residents with the opportunity to enjoy life to the fullest. With good transport accessibility to many neighbouring areas, getting around the area will never be a major problem. The presence of schools, clinics, hospitals and modern residential complexes make this neighbourhood an ideal place for a relaxed life in Dubai. This vibrant neighbourhood inspires a new lifestyle and is perfect for families who enjoy a quiet and peaceful environment.

items.name: Arabian Ranches 2
items.description:
Wadi Al Safa 7 is an upmarket neighbourhood in Dubai that offers a wide range of services and facilities to residents. Both apartments and luxury villas can be found in this neighbourhood. The villas here are presented with spacious spaces ideal for catering to the needs of a family. All apartments are equipped with balconies and are provided with day and night security services. Residents also have access to car parks, swimming pools, fitness clubs, yoga rooms and treatment rooms. The neighbourhood offers affordable housing in a comfortable family environment with all the necessary city amenities including schools, medical facilities and supermarkets in close proximity.
 With its convenient location and good transport infrastructure, the neighbourhood is easily accessible. Bus stops and metro stations provide convenient transport links to other parts of the city. Due to its good location, the neighbourhood is close to major attractions. In addition, this picturesque neighbourhood is renowned for its luxurious lifestyle. Designed for family living, it offers a high level of security, privacy and comfort. Thanks to smart planning, one can enjoy a peaceful environment and comfortable living here.

items.name: Arabian Ranches 3
items.description:
Arabian ranches 3 - community is a part of Dubailand, divided into 9 neighbourhoods.
  The neighbourhood offers many different amenities and activities for comfortable living and recreation. There is a green landscaped park of 30,000 square metres, 15 playgrounds for various sports, as well as a clubhouse and a large golf club, which is the main feature of the neighbourhood.
  There is a shopping centre, schools, kindergartens, medical facilities and supermarkets in the area. Global Village amusement park and Burj Khalifa are 10 minutes away, and Dubai Marina and JBR beach are 25 minutes away.
  The main types of property in the district are villas and townhouses, the design of which is inspired by the Arabian Desert. The facades and interiors are finished in light colours and each house has panoramic windows, which creates an elegant yet cosy atmosphere.
  Arabian Ranches 3 is ideal for family living, and investors will find it a great investment opportunity.

items.name: Arjan
items.description:
Arjan - an amazing picturesque neighbourhood located in the heart of Dubai. It attracts attention as a place of modern development and comfortable living. Arjan is known for its beautiful architecture and sophisticated building designs that create a unique look for the neighbourhood. It offers a variety of mid to high rise buildings with modern facades, beautiful green spaces and landscaped public spaces.
 Arjan also has many entertainment and sports facilities: theatres, restaurants, cafes, sports centres and playgrounds, which makes it attractive for young people and families with children. In addition, there is a well-developed infrastructure: schools, kindergartens, shops, banks and medical centres are in close proximity, which ensures comfortable living for the residents of the area. The Dubai Mall and Mall of the Emirates shopping centres are a 20-minute drive away.
 Arjan is famous for its parks and squares where you can stroll, spend time outdoors or play sports. The neighbourhood is home to Dubai's famous parks - Dubai Miracle Garden and Dubai Butterfly Garden.
This neighbourhood is ideal for those who appreciate modern comfort and high level of service. The combination of modern infrastructure, beautifully designed buildings and a variety of entertainment options makes Arjan one of the most attractive places to live and relax in Dubai.

items.name: Athlon
items.description:
Athlon by Aldar is a groundbreaking residential development in Dubailand, designed to promote a lifestyle that combines wellness, sustainability, and modern living. As Dubai’s first “Active Living” community, Athlon encourages residents to integrate physical activity into their daily routines through thoughtfully planned walking and cycling paths, landscaped parks, and sports-focused amenities.

The community offers a mix of 3–6 bedroom villas, townhouses, and apartments across multiple themed neighborhoods, each blending contemporary design with functional layouts. Residents benefit from clubhouses, fitness centers, wellness facilities, meditation zones, and recreational parks, all within a safe and family-friendly environment.

items.name: Azizi Riviera
items.description:
The Azizi Riviera at Meydan One community is a modern residential development offering a unique combination of comfort, style and modern technology in one of the city's most prestigious neighbourhoods. Located in Meydan One, Azizi Riviera offers residents and visitors a wide range of residential and commercial properties surrounded by beautiful parks, cosy squares and modern infrastructure.
 Residents of Azizi Riviera at Meydan One have access to various amenities and services such as swimming pools, fitness centres, spas, restaurants, cafes, shops, playgrounds and much more to ensure a comfortable and convenient life. In addition, recreational, walking and sporting activity areas are provided within the complex so that residents can enjoy an active lifestyle.
 Azizi Riviera at Meydan One has a prime location that allows residents easy access to Dubai's major attractions, shopping centres, restaurants, beaches and other places of interest. The favourable location provides excellent accessibility and convenience for residents, making it an attractive place to live.
 Clean air, scenic views, modern designs and functional housing layouts make Azizi Riviera at Meydan One an excellent place to live and holiday in Dubai.

items.name: Barsha Heights (TECOM)
items.description: Barsha Heights, formerly known as TECOM, is a vibrant mixed-use community in Dubai, strategically located between Sheikh Zayed Road and Hessa Street. Known for its dynamic urban lifestyle, the area hosts a mix of residential apartments, office spaces, and retail outlets, making it popular among professionals, entrepreneurs, and young families. The community is home to several business clusters, including Dubai Internet City, Dubai Media City, and Dubai Knowledge Park, providing proximity to major employment hubs. Residents enjoy easy access to public transport, metro stations, restaurants, cafes, and leisure facilities, making Barsha Heights a convenient and well-connected neighborhood that blends work, living, and entertainment in one central location.

items.name: Bluewaters Island
items.description:
Blue Waters Island is one of Dubai's exciting neighbourhoods and is an architectural and design marvel. This new island is located on the west coast and is one of the most innovative and sophisticated projects in the city.
 The main feature of Blue Waters Island is the huge Ain Dubai Ferris wheel, the largest in the world. This attraction attracts many tourists and residents, offering an extraordinary view of the bay and panorama of the city.
 In addition to Ain Dubai, Blue Waters Island is home to luxury apartment complexes, upscale hotels, numerous restaurants and cafes, boutiques and shops of famous brands. The area is a great place for walking, relaxing and shopping.
 In addition, Blue Waters Island offers a variety of entertainment and activities including beaches, spas, water sports and more. The island is also a centre for cultural events and entertainment, hosting concerts, exhibitions and festivals.
 Life on Blue Waters Island epitomises luxury, modernity and comfort, attracting successful individuals, tourists and connoisseurs of a sophisticated lifestyle. This neighbourhood of Dubai offers a unique experience and an opportunity to immerse yourself in the atmosphere of luxury and modern technology, making your stay here an unforgettable experience.

items.name: Bukadra
items.description:
Bukadra is a residential neighbourhood located in the northern part of the city. It is a cosy and comfortable place to live with well-developed infrastructure and a variety of opportunities for an active lifestyle.
 The community is characterised by a calm environment and green areas, which makes it attractive for families and those who value privacy and comfort. A variety of residential complexes including apartments and villas can be found in the area, as well as many amenities such as supermarkets, restaurants, parks and sports fields.
 Residents of Bukadra can enjoy proximity to shopping centres and entertainment venues, and have easy access to other parts of the city thanks to a well-developed transport system. The area also has educational institutions and medical centres, making it convenient for families with children.
 Bukadra is a pleasant place to live, combining the tranquillity of suburban life with the amenities of a big city. The neighbourhood has a cosy and safe atmosphere, making it attractive to different categories of residents.

items.name: Business Bay
items.description:
Business Bay is a commercial, residential and business hub straddling the Dubai Water Canal.
 The most popular and most famous attractions in Dubai are located just steps from Business Bay: Downtown, Burj Khalifa, Opera district, Dubai Mall, Souq Al Bahar.
 Business Bay has a well-connected network of connections to Sheikh Zayed Road and Al Khail Road, the two main highways that run through Dubai.
Convenient location allows you to quickly reach popular destinations: 10-minute drive to City Walk, full of exclusive shops, restaurants, entertainment events, 15 minutes to DIFC and Jumeirah beaches, and 20-30 minutes to Dubai International Airport, Palm Jumeirah , Burj Al Arab and Dubai Marina.
 Business Bay is a short walk from the Burj Khalifa metro station. There are several bus routes along the main roads of the area, and stops for public water transport and marinas for private boats have been built along the canal. The canal provides access to Dubai Creek, Jumeirah and Al Wasl.
 Schools nearby: GEMS Indian School, JSS Private School, Horizon English School, Hartland International School, Jumeirah English Speaking School.
 Housing in Business Bay is often chosen by tourists, as well as businessmen and professionals who want to live close to their place of work.

items.name: Cherrywoods
items.description: Cherrywoods is a premium residential development in Dubai, offering a tranquil and family-friendly environment with modern urban conveniences. Located in a well-connected area, it provides easy access to major roads, business districts, and leisure destinations across the city. The community features a range of spacious villas and townhouses with contemporary designs, landscaped gardens, and high-quality finishes. Residents can enjoy amenities such as swimming pools, parks, playgrounds, and fitness centers, creating a lifestyle that balances relaxation and activity. Ideal for families and professionals seeking a serene yet connected neighborhood, Cherrywoods represents a perfect blend of comfort, privacy, and modern living in Dubai.

items.name: City of Arabia
items.location: City Of Arabia, Nad Al Shiba
items.description:
City of Arabia is an ambitious neighbourhood that is designed to be one of the most spectacular urban spaces in Dubai. This unique community combines elements of entertainment, housing, commerce and culture to create a modern and exciting place to live and play.
 City of Arabia is located in the centre of Dubai, providing convenient access to all key locations and facilities in the city. It is a huge integrated project comprising high-end residential developments, luxury shopping malls, entertainment areas, parks, cinemas, restaurants and much more.
 Special attention has been paid to the architecture and design of City of Arabia to create a unique look for the place. The buildings are designed in a contemporary style using innovative technology and materials, giving the city a modern and stylish look.
 In addition to housing and shopping centres, City of Arabia also provides a variety of recreational and entertainment areas. It will be an ideal place for residents and visitors alike to spend their free time, offering a wide range of entertainment and cultural activities.
 City of Arabia is designed to symbolise modern architecture and a comfortable urban environment in Dubai. This project reflects a commitment to developing innovative and unique spaces, contributing to the city's modern image and creating a favourable environment to live and work in.

items.name: CityWalk
items.description:
City Walk is a modern and stylish destination in the heart of Dubai that combines luxury, comfort and a variety of entertainment options. The neighborhood is a unique blend of residential, commercial and entertainment infrastructure, making it attractive to both tourists and residents.
 One of the main features of City Walk is its original design, where modern architecture and cozy pedestrian streets are intertwined with many green spaces and well-maintained squares. The neighborhood is decorated with modern artificial installations and sculptures, creating a unique atmosphere.
 Here you can find many fashionable boutiques, haute cuisine restaurants, cafes and coffee shops, as well as various entertainment venues. The neighborhood is known for its chic shopping plazas, featuring both local and global brands.
 The area also offers a variety of sports and entertainment options including fitness clubs, playgrounds, movie theaters, and bowling alleys. In the evening, the neighborhood comes alive with various cultural and entertainment events, concerts and festivals.
 City Walk is the perfect blend of comfort, style and modernity that allows its visitors to enjoy the atmosphere of a progressive and creative Dubai.

items.name: DIFC (Dubai International Financial Center)
items.description:
Dubai International Financial Centre (DIFC) - an ultra-modern community with a very well-developed infrastructure that attracts tourists, residence seekers and major investors. 
 The main types of property in the area are residential and commercial properties built in accordance with the latest architectural trends. Residential complexes take into account the needs of consumers and present both compact apartments for single person living and spacious residences for couples with children. Commercial property is located on the ground floors of the complexes or in freestanding buildings.  
 The area also offers social facilities such as retail outlets, restaurants, cafes and other organisations specialising in the provision of services. Schools, kindergartens, medical centres are within walking distance.
 Investments in the property of the district can bring a stable income.

items.name: Damac Hills
items.description:
Damac Hills is a picturesque luxury neighbourhood in the heart of Dubai, an oasis of luxury, comfort and diversity. Rainbow gardens, lush parks and azure lakes create a unique atmosphere of harmony and peace. The neighbourhood is a perfect blend of modern urban style and natural beauty, inviting every guest to experience a world of serenity and sophistication.
 Properties in Damac Hills are stunningly diverse and exquisitely designed. There are luxurious villas, stylish apartments and cosy townhouses offering the highest level of comfort and enjoyment. Residents of this area can enjoy top-notch services and amenities such as spacious swimming pools, fitness centres, world-class restaurants and lavish gardens.
 In addition, Damac Hills is known for its top-notch golf courses that attract both lovers of this noble sport and professional golfers. Residents of the neighbourhood can enjoy playing on green lawns surrounded by beautiful landscapes and exquisite architectural structures.
 Another feature of Damac Hills is its infrastructure. From kindergartens and schools to shopping centres and medical facilities, all the necessary amenities can be found here. The neighbourhood also has convenient transport links and easy access to major roads and the airport.

items.name: Damac Hills 2
items.description:
Damac Hills 2 is a luxury neighbourhood located in the heart of Dubai that combines luxury and comfortable living amidst picturesque green landscapes, breathtaking views of the golf course and amazing lakes. The neighbourhood is characterised by a high level of infrastructure and amenities that provide its residents with a luxurious lifestyle.
 The area offers a wide range of spacious and modern apartments, townhouses and villas, decorated in the best traditions of modern design and equipped with the latest technology. Every detail has been thought out to ensure the comfort and cosiness of its residents.
 In addition to luxurious accommodation, Damac Hills 2 offers many opportunities for active recreation and entertainment. Residents can enjoy golfing on top-class courses, visit top-class restaurants and cafes, work out at state-of-the-art sports clubs, relax at spas or stroll through beautiful parks and gardens.
 Damac Hills 2 also offers convenient transport accessibility due to its unique location. The area is in close proximity to the main tourist and business centres of the city, making it an ideal place to live for locals and international visitors alike.
 The atmosphere of the neighbourhood allows you to immerse yourself in a world of luxury, comfort and beauty. Damac Hills 2 is the ideal place for those who appreciate quality of life and seek true well-being.

items.name: Damac Islands 1
items.description:
DAMAC Islands is a luxurious, island-inspired master community by DAMAC Properties, located in the vibrant Dubailand area of Dubai. Spanning a vast expanse of land, the development is designed to recreate the feeling of a private resort, with themed clusters inspired by world-famous destinations such as Hawaii, Bali, Fiji, Maldives, Bora Bora, and Seychelles. Crystal-clear lagoons, white sandy beaches, and lush landscapes form the heart of this unique waterfront lifestyle.

The community offers a selection of elegantly designed townhouses and villas, ranging from 4- and 5-bedroom townhouses to 6- and 7-bedroom villas. Each residence features modern interiors, spacious layouts, and panoramic views of the lagoons, ensuring a seamless connection between indoor luxury and outdoor living.

items.name: Damac Lagoons
items.description: Damac Lagoons is a luxurious waterfront community in Dubai, designed to offer a resort-style lifestyle with vibrant amenities and scenic landscapes. The development features a collection of villas, townhouses, and apartments inspired by Mediterranean architecture, set around crystal-clear lagoons and private beaches. Residents can enjoy a wide range of leisure and entertainment options, including water parks, retail outlets, restaurants, and recreational facilities. Strategically located with easy access to Sheikh Zayed Road and other key areas, Damac Lagoons combines modern urban living with a serene, coastal environment. It is an ideal choice for families, investors, and those seeking a high-quality lifestyle in one of Dubai’s most ambitious master communities.

items.name: Damac Riverside
items.location: Damac Riverside (all buildings), Dubai Investment Park Second
items.description:
DAMAC Riverside is a premium residential community by DAMAC Properties, located within Dubai Investment Park 2 (DIP 2). Designed to blend modern urban living with nature and waterfront charm, the development offers residents a unique lifestyle where tranquility meets convenience. Its carefully planned layout combines lush green spaces with serene waterways, creating an environment that feels both private and vibrant.

The community features a range of elegantly designed townhouses, villas, and apartments, catering to diverse family needs. Townhouses and villas come with 4 to 5 bedrooms, offering spacious layouts and private outdoor areas, while the Riverside Views apartments provide contemporary 1- and 2-bedroom options with stunning views of landscaped gardens and waterways.

DAMAC Riverside is distinguished by its dual-theme lifestyle concept. The Green Vein emphasizes wellness and sustainability, featuring landscaped parks, hydroponic gardens, and dedicated family spaces. The Water Vein focuses on leisure, offering waterfront dining, floating sports facilities, and recreational areas designed for relaxation and entertainment.

items.name: Deira
items.description:
Deira is one of the oldest districts in Dubai, located along the Dubai Creek. It is in Deira that most of the traditional oriental bazaars are located.
An integral part of the Deira area is the gold and spice markets. These are colorful oriental bazaars on the shores of Dubai Creek, where they sell gold, perfumes, incense, spices and coffee.
The local canal has always been the center of Dubai's trade and today, like hundreds of years ago, both large ships and small dhows carrying people and goods ply along it.
An evening walk along the picturesque embankment will be a great end to the day.

items.name: Discovery gardens
items.description:
Discovery Gardens is a safe and tranquil neighborhood in the southwest of Dubai, which attracts a variety of residents and investors from around the world due to its many amenities and entertainment options.
 The key feature of the neighborhood is its green spaces. There are several parks and gardens where residents can enjoy outdoor walks or activities at the many sports and playgrounds. The presence of good schools and kindergartens makes the area attractive to families with children, while quick access to the city's business centers and business areas attracts young professionals.
 Next to Discovery Gardens is Dubai Marina Walk, a famous promenade with many restaurants, cafes and stores. One of the largest shopping centers in Dubai, Ibn Battuta Mall, is a 10-minute drive away.Discovery Gardens is also located near the famous JBR beach and the large Jebel Ali Park with a variety of entertainment and restaurants.

items.name: Downtown Dubai
items.description: Downtown Dubai, often called the "Heart of Dubai," is the city’s most iconic and vibrant district. Home to the world-famous Burj Khalifa, Dubai Mall, and Dubai Fountain, it perfectly blends luxury living, entertainment, and business opportunities. The area features stunning residential towers, premium hotels, and upscale retail spaces, making it a hotspot for investors, residents, and tourists alike. With its central location, modern infrastructure, and breathtaking cityscape views, Downtown Dubai represents the pinnacle of urban lifestyle in the UAE.

items.name: Dubai Airport Free Zone
items.description: A specialized zone with a special economic status, Dubai Airport Free Zone, was founded in the mid-90s, and since that time has been constantly and actively developing and improving. The main advantage of this free zone is that it operates at the Dubai International Air Harbor. Several thousand international companies operating in a wide variety of industries are registered in the Dubai Airport Free Zone. Logistics and aviation, cargo and passenger transportation, pharmaceuticals and food, jewelry and household appliances, modern information technologies, etc.

items.name: Dubai Creek Harbour
items.description:
Dubai Creek Harbour is a coastal area divided into 9 neighborhoods that perfectly combine modern living with the concept of caring for the environment.  
  The total area of the district - 5.5 million square meters.
  Dubai Creek Harbour is one of the most prestigious waterfronts in the world, it has everything for a comfortable life, work and leisure. In the neighborhood is located reserve Ras Al Khor, where there are about 450 species of rare animals, as well as the famous pink flamingos. There are landscaped green park with many jogging, walking and biking paths, playgrounds for various sports, shopping centers, cinemas and a large number of cafes and elite restaurants. The Downtown business district is just a 10-minute drive from Dubai Creek Harbour, and the JBR and Dubai Marina beaches can be reached in 30 minutes.
  The main types of real estate in the area are residential complexes with unique designs in a modern style. Each building has swimming pools and gyms, as well as concierge services and 24-hour security.
 With its advantages and convenient infrastructure Dubai Creek Harbour is an ideal place for personal or family living, and tourist attraction makes the area an option for the most profitable investment.

items.name: Dubai Design District
items.description:
Dubai Design District (D3) is an innovative and creative neighbourhood in Dubai specifically designed to foster the design, fashion, art and culture industries. It concentrates offices, shops, studios and galleries that create a unique environment for creative professionals and art lovers.
 The district has become a centre of global design and innovation, attracting talented designers, architects, artists and creative entrepreneurs from around the world. It hosts a variety of events, exhibitions, conferences and festivals that encourage the exchange of ideas and inspire new projects.
 The Dubai Design District is home to a variety of shops and boutiques offering exclusive fashion, design and interior collections. There are also state-of-the-art studios and laboratories where designers and artists can bring their ideas to life.
 One of the main features of the neighbourhood is its architecture. The buildings in the neighbourhood are designed in a modern style, combining innovative solutions with sophisticated design. The district has become not only a place of work and creativity, but also a source of inspiration for all those interested in contemporary art and design.
 Dubai Design District is a unique space where creative energies and ideas are focussed, contributing to the development of the design and cultural industries.

items.name: Dubai Expo City
items.description:
Dubai Expo City is an eco-friendly, high-tech, car-free district that is home to a new museum, a world-class exhibition centre and an eco-friendly home for business headquarters, start-ups and SMEs.
Adjacent to Expo 2020 Dubai, the Dubai Expo City neighbourhood is a cutting-edge infrastructure that combines state-of-the-art technology, smart solutions and amenities for all who live and work here.
 Dubai Expo City is a space for creativity, development and the exchange of ideas. Modern office buildings, shopping centres, restaurants, hotels and much more can be found here. The neighbourhood is designed to provide residents and visitors with everything they need to live a comfortable and productive life.
 Dubai Expo City offers a wide range of entertainment and opportunities for an active lifestyle. Modern sports clubs, parks, cosy cafes and walking areas make it an attractive destination for all ages. Residents of the neighbourhood can enjoy endless recreational opportunities right at their doorstep.
 In addition, Dubai Expo City offers the highest level of safety, infrastructure and convenience to its residents. State-of-the-art technology and innovations in urban management make the neighbourhood one of the most advanced and comfortable places to live in Dubai.

items.name: Dubai Festival City
items.description:
Dubai Festival City is set to become the flagship venue for Dubai and the region as a whole. Its main distinguishing feature from other housing construction projects is its close proximity to the water area (the complex will stretch along the eastern shores of the Dubai Historical Bay, which is a vivid reminder of the ancient traditions of sea voyages from the Arabian port and serves not only as the central geographical location of Dubai, but also as the ancestor of the modern Emirates ).
Dubai Festival City (Arabic: دبي فستيفال سيتي‎‎‎) is a large multifunctional complex in Dubai (UAE). Includes condos, hotels, malls, golf course and entertainment establishments.
Construction began in 2003 and is scheduled to take 12 years to complete. The complex is spread over 3.8 km along the coast of Dubai Creek, 2 km from Dubai International Airport. By 2006, $3 billion had already been invested in the project.
W Hotel Dubai and Four Seasons Hotel Dubai are being built in the complex.
Dubai Festival City is home to the Festival Waterfront Center shopping complex, housing major supermarkets such as IKEA, HyperPanda, ElectroniX and Ace Hardware.

items.name: Dubai Harbour
items.description:
Emaar Beachfront is an artificial island located between Palm Jumeirah and Jumeirah Beach Residence. 
 Beachfront is a closed luxury neighborhood. Here is concentrated all the necessary infrastructure for comfortable living, work and recreation. Residents have access to a 1.5 km long private promenade, swimming pools, gyms, children's playgrounds and sports grounds, recreation areas with barbecue facilities and the largest marina with 1,400 berths.
  The area is home to the best educational and medical facilities, kindergartens, cafes and fine dining restaurants. Dubai Marina Walk is just 5 minutes away, Dubai Media City and Dubai Knowledge Park are 10 minutes away and Burj Khalifa and Dubai Mall are 25 minutes away.
The main real estate in Beachfront- multi-storey residential complexes with apartments and penthouses and coastal villas. The main and only developer is Emaar. All buildings and residences are decorated in a modern style, with panoramic windows and beautiful views of Palm Jumeirah Island and Palm Jumeirah.
Beachfront is a great place for a comfortable life, and investors can count on a stable income.

items.name: Dubai Hills
items.description:
Dubai Hills is a closed cottage complex that includes absolutely everything you need for a comfortable and luxurious life.
 The neighborhood is one of the most ecological, a significant part of the territory is allocated for parks and gardens. 
 Dubai Hills is ideal for families with children, there are four schools, a huge park with playgrounds, volleyball field, tennis court, skate park, bike paths, swimming pools and landscaped areas for recreation with hammocks.
 The main attraction of the neighborhood is its own 18-hole golf course overlooking the Burj Khalifa, and the largest park Dubai Hills Park, where you can relax and enjoy nature. Also in the area is the large Dubai Hills Mall with many different stores.
 The main types of real estate in the area are villas and townhouses. Buildings in Dubai Hills as a separate kind of art - are able to surprise with their beauty and harmony.

items.name: Dubai Industrial City
items.description: Dubai Industrial Park (Dubai Industrial City) is a designated area within the Dubai Wholesale City, one of the largest industrial centers of Dubai. DIC was created with the aim of rapid growth and expansion of the industrial sector in the United Arab Emirates, especially aiming to attract players in the light and medium industry sectors with a special focus on food and beverages, base metals, transport equipment and spare parts. , machinery and mechanical equipment, workshops, logistics, chemicals and mineral products.

items.name: Dubai International City
items.description:
Dubai International City is a vibrant international neighborhood represented by a variety of cultures and architectural styles. The neighborhood is located near Dubai Silicon Oasis and Dubai Academic City, making it a popular place to live for students, workers and locals.
 The neighborhood is divided into several zones, each with its own unique design and theme reflecting different countries and cultures: China Cluster, France Cluster, Greece Cluster, Italy Cluster, Spain Cluster, etc. In each zone you can find architectural elements characteristic of the respective country.
 Dubai International City offers a wide range of residential and commercial real estate including apartments, villas, stores, restaurants and offices. The neighborhood is also known for its budget housing options, making it attractive to students, workers and families.
 The neighborhood has many green spaces, parks, and walking alleys where residents and visitors can enjoy outdoor activities. There are also shopping centers where you can find everything you need for a comfortable life, various cafes and restaurants offering a variety of cuisines from around the world.
Dubai International City is a dynamic and cosmopolitan place where different cultures and nationalities neighbor, creating a unique and interesting atmosphere.

items.name: Dubai Investment Park
items.description:
Dubai Investments Park (DIP) is a major industrial, logistics and residential neighborhood located in the southwest of Dubai. The community is a modern, well-planned and developed area attractive for both business and living.
 The area has excellent infrastructure including wide roads, public transportation network, parking lots, stores, restaurants, pharmacies, banks, and medical and educational facilities. It also includes spacious residential areas with a variety of housing ranging from apartments and houses to villas and townhouses.
 The Dubai Investments Park area is also home to many industrial and warehouse complexes, making it attractive to various manufacturing and logistics companies. It is also home to office buildings, business centers and areas for retail and services.
 DIP is a strategically important area for Dubai's economy, providing good opportunities for business development and entrepreneurship. Also, the area has a favorable ecological environment due to green spaces, parks and well-maintained landscapes.
 Dubai Investments Park is a modern and functional neighborhood that provides residents and entrepreneurs with everything they need for a comfortable life and successful business in the heart of Dubai.

items.name: Dubai Islands
items.description:
Dubai Islands is an upscale and prestigious neighbourhood that is an island on an artificial archipelago. The community is one of the most luxurious and attractive places to live and holiday in the city.
 Dubai Islands is characterised by luxurious high-rise buildings, unique and amazing architecture and huge shopping complexes. Luxury residences, world-class hotels, luxurious spas, fine dining restaurants, exclusive boutiques and yacht bays can be found here.
 The area is also famous for its gorgeous beaches with fine sand and crystal clear water. Here you can enjoy sunbathing, swimming in the pool or strolling along the promenade while enjoying stunning views of the Persian Gulf.
 Dubai Islands also offers a wide range of entertainment and cultural activities such as exhibitions, festivals, concerts and sporting events. The neighbourhood is also known for its parks and green spaces where you can relax and enjoy nature in the heart of the city's hustle and bustle.
 Living in the Dubai Islands neighbourhood combines luxury, comfort and a high level of service, making it an ideal choice for those seeking an exceptional lifestyle in one of Dubai's most prestigious areas.

items.name: Dubai Life style City
items.location: Dubai Life Style City, Wadi Al Safa 7
items.description: Dubai Lifestyle City is a modern master-planned community designed to offer a balanced blend of luxury, convenience, and family-friendly living. The development features a mix of villas, townhouses, and apartments set within landscaped surroundings, providing residents with a serene and comfortable environment. With a focus on wellness and recreation, the community includes parks, walking and cycling tracks, fitness centers, and retail amenities, ensuring a vibrant lifestyle for families and professionals alike. Strategically located with easy access to major roads and Dubai’s key destinations, Dubai Lifestyle City offers a harmonious combination of urban convenience, leisure facilities, and peaceful suburban living, making it an ideal choice for residents and investors seeking long-term value.

items.name: Dubai Marina
items.description:
Dubai Marina is located along the Gulf Coast, in close proximity to the Palm Jumeirah, the largest Ferris wheel Ain Dubai and JBR beach.

The area is one of the smallest in Dubai, with an area of only 4 square kilometers, but at the same time it is one of the most popular areas for living, tourism and recreation.

There are more than 300 residential and office skyscrapers, prestigious hotels, beautiful beaches, coastline with restaurants and cafes. The bay is home to four yacht clubs where you can rent or even buy a yacht.

items.name: Dubai Motor City
items.description:
Motor City is a unique neighborhood built around the Dubai Autodrome, which hosts many events including the famous Dubai 24 Hour Race and the Dubai Grand Prix.
The neighborhood is ideal for tourists, living and vacationing with children. Motor City has a large number of amenities and entertainment: 
- Several parks: one of them isGreen Community Motor City Park, a stunning clean and safe place with a scenic lake, jogging trail, children's playground, basketball court and picnic area.
- Restaurants to suit all tastes, from simple burgers to sumptuous Italian cuisine. 
- GymNation Motor City Fitness Center, 
-Prime Medical Center Motor City, which has the latest equipment and the most qualified doctors and nurses.

items.name: Dubai Production City
items.description:
Dubai Production City (DPC) is a great place for families and individuals looking for an accessible and affordable lifestyle in Dubai with a range of housing options, amenities, and transportation links.
Hosting numerous businesses in the fields of publishing, printing and packaging, it provides smart and advanced infrastructure, and choices that range from commercial offices to warehouses with flexible spaces that meet various requirements. The business-friendly environment stimulates innovation and creativity, provides the highest levels of operational efficiency and enhances success rates.

DPC is also close to major landmarks and attractions such as Dubai Miracle Garden, Dubai Autodrome, and Global Village. The area is accessible by bus, taxi, and car. Dubai International Airport and Dubai World Central Airport are about 30 minutes away.
Several schools located in and around the area are GEMS Metropole School, Dubai British School, and Indian High School. 
 Future development plans in the area include the construction of new residential and commercial buildings, expansion of public transportation options which is expected to drive up real estate prices in the coming years.

items.name: Dubai Residence Complex
items.location: Dubai Land Residence Complex, Wadi Al Safa 5
items.description: Dubailand Residence Complex is a neighbourhood that is rapidly gaining popularity for its affordability and quality of life. The neighbourhood offers a variety of entertainment and shopping facilities as well as gyms. Its location is strategic due to its close proximity to major roads. The buildings of the complex stand out for their modern stone and glass design, innovative technology and functionality. The neighbourhood attracts different audiences: families with children, young professionals and expatriates. Aquila school, medical clinics, supermarkets and restaurants are located here. Transport accessibility and proximity to attractions such as Dubai Miracle Garden and IMG Worlds of Adventure make the area attractive for living and investment. The development offers a variety of property types including flats, offices and shops with modern amenities and high quality of life.

items.name: Dubai Silicon Oasis
items.description:
Dubai Silicon Oasis is one of the leading innovation and technology centres in Dubai and the Middle East. It was established to support the development of high-tech industries and foster innovation in the region.
 The DSO offers a variety of opportunities for companies involved in information technology, electronics, engineering research and development. It is home to modern office buildings, laboratories, startup incubators, and infrastructure for testing and implementing new technologies.
 Residential infrastructure is present in the neighbourhood, making it attractive to professionals and families looking to live and work in an innovative environment. In addition, Dubai Silicon Oasis has various educational institutions, shopping centres, cafes and restaurants, providing residents with everything they need for a comfortable life.
 The district also actively supports startups and innovative projects through various programmes and initiatives, fostering an ecosystem for tech entrepreneurship. The overall atmosphere in Dubai Silicon Oasis is saturated with the spirit of innovation, ideas and opportunities for the development of modern technologies.

items.name: Dubai South
items.description:
Dubai South, also known as Dubai World Central, is one of Dubai's most dynamic neighbourhoods. This mixed-use urban space combines residential, commercial, transport and entertainment facilities to create a unique environment for work, leisure and living.
 Dubai South occupies a strategic location - it is just 30 minutes from the centre of Dubai and in close proximity to Al Maktoum International Airport. The neighbourhood is also home to the EXPO 2020 World Expo, giving it a special status and attracting attention from all over the world.
 Dubai South offers modern homes, business centres, educational institutions, sports facilities, shopping malls and plenty of green spaces for rest and relaxation. It is also home to innovative infrastructure projects such as Hyperloop One and Drone Hub, making the neighbourhood a place of cutting-edge technology and ideas for the future.
 Dubai South offers rich opportunities for business, investment as well as quality living for its residents. The neighbourhood not only reflects the luxury and modernity of Dubai, but also strives to create an innovative and sustainable environment where people can realise their ambitious plans and dreams.

items.name: Dubai Sports City
items.location: Dubai Sports City, Al Hebiah Fourth
items.description:
Dubai Sports City (DSC) is a neighbourhood with well-developed infrastructure, ideal for a healthy lifestyle away from the bustling metropolis.
The area has different types of real estate (villas, apartments, townhouses), sports, shopping and entertainment centres, a sports academy and a football school.
For residents and visitors there are rugby, golf and baseball pitches, a cricket stadium, bowling clubs, and indoor and outdoor sports grounds.
Supermarkets, pharmacies, cafes, Dubai Sports City restaurants, beauty salons, bakeries and clinics are all within walking distance of the neighbourhood. 
DSC is designed in a country style, which creates a feeling of comfort and cosiness. You can live here with your family and do your favourite activities.

items.name: Dubai Studio City
items.location: Dubai Studio City, Al Hebiah Second
items.description:
Dubai Studio City is a unique neighbourhood in Dubai that is specifically designed to develop the media and entertainment industry. This creative cluster offers a wide range of opportunities for film production, television programmes, music videos, advertising and other media projects.
 The Dubai Studio City neighbourhood has a state-of-the-art infrastructure specifically tailored to the needs of the media industry. Film studios, recording studios, equipped film sets, editing studios and other production and post-production facilities can be found here.
 In addition, Dubai Studio City provides a wide range of office space, co-working spaces and business centres for media and entertainment companies. It is also home to schools and training centres specialising in media and arts education.
 Dubai Studio City epitomises the desire for innovation and creativity, providing a platform for creative development and projects in the media industry. State-of-the-art technology, unique opportunities for collaboration, and a favourable business environment make Dubai Studio City an attractive location for both local and international companies and creative professionals.

items.name: EMAAR South
items.description: Emaar South is a vibrant, master-planned community in Dubai, located near the Expo 2020 site and Al Maktoum International Airport, offering a perfect blend of urban convenience and suburban tranquility. The community features a wide range of villas, townhouses, and apartments, designed with modern architecture and thoughtful layouts. Residents enjoy world-class amenities including parks, retail centers, schools, sports facilities, and leisure spaces, fostering a family-friendly environment.
