With its strategic location and connectivity to major roads, Emaar South is ideal for professionals, families, and investors looking for a balanced lifestyle, strong rental yields, and long-term capital appreciation in one of Dubai’s fastest-growing communities.

items.name: Emirates Hills
items.description:
Emirates Hills is a large-scale world-class complex, an elite golf community with an area of 12 square kilometers, one of the most prestigious, sought-after and closed complexes in the city. Advertised as the ”Beverly Hills in Dubai", this exclusive residential area is replete with the most modern amenities, beautiful scenery and stunning panoramic views.
The area was originally designed and built up as an elite area for the wealthiest residents, so the master plan included numerous artificial ponds, canals and several golf courses. All public places, parks, lake shores and green areas are landscaped and maintained by the best landscape designers.
Emirates Hills is a low-rise residential area. There are no buildings with a height of more than 2 floors and no apartment buildings.
From the area there is a direct access to the main transport artery of the emirate - the Sheikh Zayed Road.

items.name: Grand Polo Club & Resort
items.location: Grand Polo Club & Resort, Dubai Investment Park Second
items.description:
Grand Polo Club & Resort by Emaar is a breathtaking new luxury community redefining elite living in Dubai. Spread across more than 5.5 million square meters, this master development brings together the charm of equestrian lifestyle and the sophistication of modern design, setting a new benchmark for resort-style living in the UAE.

Located in Dubai Investment Park, near Dubai South and Expo Road (E77), the community enjoys seamless access to major highways and the Al Maktoum International Airport. This prime location ensures residents are close to the city’s key destinations while surrounded by vast open landscapes and tranquility.

items.name: Haven
items.location: Haven By Aldar (all phases), Wadi Al Safa 5
items.description: Haven by Aldar is a thoughtfully designed residential community that blends modern living with comfort and convenience. Located in a well-connected area, the development offers a range of apartments and townhouses with contemporary layouts, high-quality finishes, and spacious interiors. Residents benefit from a variety of amenities including landscaped gardens, swimming pools, fitness centers, children’s play areas, and retail outlets, creating a lifestyle that caters to families and professionals alike. With easy access to major roads, schools, and leisure destinations, Haven by Aldar provides a serene and secure environment while remaining connected to the vibrant heart of the city, making it an ideal choice for both living and investment.

items.name: Hessyan Second
items.description: Hessyan Second is a prime residential neighborhood placed in the heart of Dubai. It has a range of residential units including villas, townhouses, apartments and staff quarters. Featuring residential units in various layouts, the amenities and facilities on offer are truly first class. With beautiful gardens and modern architecture, the residents of the community lead a convenient lifestyle.

items.name: JLT (Jumeirah Lake Towers)
items.description:
Jumeirah Lake Towers (JLT) is a neighborhood on the coastal area of the Persian Gulf, ideal for living, recreation and entertainment. The total area is 1,800,800 square meters
 JLT is named after the artificial lakes located in the center of the district. Green parks and Marina Beach and JBR Beach make the neighborhood attractive for residents and for numerous tourists. There are also many different stores, the nearest major shopping center is Dubai Marina Mall.
 This area is chosen by businessmen and investors, as it attracts a convenient location and amenities that provide a large flow of tourists all year round.

items.name: JVC (Jumeirah Village Circle)
items.description:
Jumeirah Village Circle or JVC is a neighborhood in Dubai with over 2000 residential properties. The master developer of the neighborhood is Nakheel Company, which clearly monitors the quality of projects.
The neighborhood is designed with comfortable living and working conditions for young couples and families with children.
In 15 minutes you can reach Dubai Marina, Dubai Internet city and Dubai Media city. At the same distance is Mall of the Emirates. Dubai Hills mall can be reached in 10 minutes. The Downtown area and The Dubai Mall are within 15 minutes from JVC.
- Dubai Miracle Garden, the largest flower garden in the world, is located in a nearby neighborhood and can be reached in 10 minutes. More than 50 million flowers are planted here on 72,000 square meters. Tourists from all over the world visit this park.
- Legoland is a theme park. Here you can energize yourself on more than 40 rides.
- JSS International School
- Circle mall is a shopping center where you will find many stores, cafes, a children's play center and a hypermarket.
The neighborhood is attractive to investors as an option for resale, short or long term rentals.

items.name: JVT (Jumeirah Village Triangle)
items.location: Jumeirah Village Triangle, Jumeirah Village Triangle (JVT)
items.description:
Jumeirah Village Triangle (JVT) is a rapidly developing district located between Sheikh Mohammed Bin Zayed Road and Al Khail Road. The convenient location allows residents of the neighborhood to have quick access to popular areas of Dubai such as Dubai Marina.
Everything for comfortable living is available here:
-parking lots
-schools
-parks and BBQ areas
-fitness centers and much more.
JVT is a safe, quiet and eco-friendly area, which is suitable for families with children, as well as for those who just want to relax and enjoy a relaxing life.
The main types of real estate in the area - apartments, villas, townhouses.

items.name: Jabal Ali Industrial 1
items.description:
Jebel Ali Industrial Area is an industrial area or industrial zone in the deepwater harbor of the United Arab Emirates in the city of Dubai in Jebel Ali. Jebel Ali Industrial Area was established in 1985.
The port itself, which has the most modern equipment for container transportation, is located 35 km southwest of the city of Dubai. In the recent past, Jebel Ali was a small coastal village, and today it is almost adjacent to the rapidly growing city.
The Jebel Ali Free Zone is located nearby. Representatives of more than 5,000 companies, attracted by tax benefits and good business conditions, work in the district. This makes the Jebel Ali Free Zone an important business center, and the port is the largest in the Middle East and in the world.
The vast spaces of Jebel Ali Industrial are very attractive for the acquisition of industrial real estate. The convenient location provides this area with stable economic growth.

items.name: Jabal Ali Industrial 2
items.description:
Jebel Ali Freezone Extension (JAFZA) is a dynamically developing area in Dubai, which is considered one of the largest and most prestigious economic centers not only in the UAE, but in the entire region. JAFZA offers a wide range of business opportunities ranging from office and warehouse space to infrastructure, specialized services and investor privileges.
 Located near Jebel Ali Port, the area has easy access to sea lanes and logistics infrastructure, making it an attractive location for companies involved in international trade and logistics. Due to the high level of service and security provided by JAFZA, many large international companies choose the area for their offices and manufacturing facilities.
 JAFZA is also known for its innovative technological solutions, digital infrastructure and digitalization of processes, which helps to increase business efficiency and create conditions for the development of high-tech industries. The district offers a variety of investment opportunities as well as privileges including 100% foreign plot, no gross income and trade tax, and a simple company registration procedure.

items.name: Jabal Ali Industrial 3
items.description: Jabal Ali Industrial 3 is a key commercial and industrial hub in Dubai, strategically located near Sheikh Zayed Road and the Jebel Ali Port, offering excellent connectivity to major business and logistics centers. The area primarily consists of warehouses, workshops, factories, and office spaces, catering to a wide range of industries including manufacturing, logistics, and trading. With functional infrastructure, ample parking, and proximity to transport links, Jabal Ali Industrial 3 provides businesses with a highly efficient and accessible operational base. Its central location, combined with supportive services such as retail outlets and dining facilities, makes Jabal Ali Industrial 3 a preferred choice for companies seeking a well-connected industrial environment in Dubai.

items.name: Jabal Ali Third
items.description: Jabal Ali Third is a well-planned residential and commercial community in Dubai, offering a strategic location with easy access to Sheikh Zayed Road, Jebel Ali Port, and nearby business hubs. The area features a mix of apartments, villas, and commercial spaces, supported by essential amenities such as schools, supermarkets, healthcare centers, and retail outlets. Known for its functional infrastructure, quiet streets, and connectivity, Jabal Ali Third provides a balanced lifestyle for families, professionals, and investors looking for a convenient and well-connected community in Dubai.

items.name: Jebel Ali Village
items.location: Jebel Ali Village Villas, Jabal Ali First
items.description:
The Jebel Ali Village neighbourhood is a picturesque area located south of central Dubai, close to Jebel Ali Port and the industrial zone. This neighbourhood offers a combination of a tranquil countryside atmosphere with the amenities of a modern city.
 Jebel Ali Village is famous for its cosy residential areas consisting of villas and townhouses surrounded by green parks and small lakes. Here, residents and visitors to the area can enjoy picturesque views of the mountains and the bay, as well as enjoy extensive infrastructure including shops, restaurants, sports and children's playgrounds.
 The area is also home to large shopping centres where you can shop, visit cafes and entertainment venues. Popular tourist attractions such as an aqua park and theme park are located close to the area, making it attractive to holidaymakers and entertainment lovers.
 With its excellent infrastructure, beautiful nature and tranquil environment, Jebel Ali Village is a popular place for family living and secluded holidays surrounded by nature, away from the hustle and bustle of the city. Convenient transport links allow easy access to the centre of Dubai, as well as other areas and attractions of the city.

items.name: Jumeirah Bay
items.description:
Jumeirah Bay is a striking waterfront residential development in Dubai, offering a modern lifestyle with a focus on comfort, convenience, and panoramic views. Strategically located along key thoroughfares, it combines urban connectivity with serene waterside living, making it an attractive choice for professionals, families, and investors alike.

The community features mid-rise and high-rise apartments, designed with contemporary architecture and open layouts that maximize natural light and offer breathtaking views of the surrounding water and landscaped areas. Residences range from 1 to 4 bedrooms, catering to singles, couples, and families looking for a blend of luxury and practicality.

items.name: Jumeirah Beach Residence (JBR)
items.description: Jumeirah Beach Residence (JBR) is one of Dubai’s most iconic waterfront communities, offering a vibrant lifestyle with a perfect mix of luxury living, leisure, and entertainment. Located along Dubai Marina, JBR features a wide range of apartments and penthouses with stunning views of the Arabian Gulf and easy access to the beach. The community is renowned for The Walk and The Beach, bustling promenades lined with retail outlets, cafes, restaurants, and entertainment options. With family-friendly amenities, fitness centers, parks, and proximity to Dubai Marina Mall and major transport links, JBR is ideal for residents and investors seeking a lively, cosmopolitan coastal lifestyle in the heart of Dubai.

items.name: Jumeirah First
items.description:
Jumeirah is the most sought-after coastal area of Dubai among wealthy people and tourists. It is this place in the emirate that has long been considered synonymous with luxury and wealth. Here are the best beaches of the emirate and the most premium real estate.

Jumeirah is an ideal place to invest in luxury real estate in Dubai. Real estate in this part of the metropolis ranges from private villas and townhouses to apartments in apartment buildings.

The construction of the area began in the 1960s and one of the first luxury residences built there were representatives of the sheikh's family. The peak of Jumeirah's development began about 20 years ago. Then premium hotels, huge shopping centers, elite restaurants were built here. The calling card of this part of the emirate is without a doubt almost 14 km long beaches with crystal clear sea and golden sand.

items.name: Jumeirah Golf Estates
items.description:
Jumeirah Golf Estates is one of Dubai's prestigious residential areas and a family-friendly area offering a variety of amenities and services.
The area is a great option for those who are passionate about sports, healthy living and nature. There is a wide range of amenities including golf courses, a swimming pool, a tennis court, bike paths, jogging tracks, a state-of-the-art fitness studio and a pool table. In addition to all this, Jumeirah Golf Estates has five wonderful lakes.
 As the area is located a 5-minute drive from one of Dubai's main roads, Sheikh Zayed Road, residents of Jumeirah Golf Estates have easy access to other areas of Dubai.
 In total, Jumeirah Golf Estates has 16 unique neighborhoods. The communities adjacent to the Course of the Earth are inspired by Mediterranean architecture, and the houses on the Course of Fire embody the desert theme. Set amidst greenery, Jumeirah Golf Estates offers a tranquil environment for those who want to be in harmony with nature.
 Schools nearby: Sanmarque School, Arcadia Preparatory School, Bradenton Preparatory Academy, GEMS Consolidated School, Choueifat International School.
 Properties at Jumeirah Golf Estates include luxury villas, townhouses and apartments. In addition, each villa has its own garden. The starting price is 1.5M AED.

items.name: Jumeirah Golf Estates – The Next Chapter
Jumeirah Heights
items.description:
Jumeirah Heights is an exclusive residential community in Dubai, designed to offer families a balance of luxury, privacy, and convenience. Located close to Sheikh Zayed Road and Dubai Marina, it provides seamless connectivity to the city’s major business, leisure, and retail hubs while maintaining a tranquil, suburban environment.

The community features spacious villas and townhouses, typically ranging from 3 to 6 bedrooms, with private gardens, modern layouts, and contemporary architecture. Interiors are thoughtfully designed to maximize natural light, space, and comfort, catering to families seeking premium living standards.

items.name: Jumeirah Islands
items.description:
Jumeirah Islands is a picturesque coastal area surrounded by crystal clear waters and spectacular scenery. There are numerous canals, lakes and parks that create a relaxing atmosphere.

The islands have many different amenities and services for a comfortable stay. Jogging and biking paths, fitness center, swimming pools, recreational areas, and proximity to the waterfront all allow residents to live an active lifestyle and engage in a variety of sports.

Jumeirah Islands is located in close proximity to Dubai Marina, Palm Jumeirah, JBR beach, and just a few minutes away is a large shopping center Mall of the Emirates.

The main type of real estate in the area - villas and townhouses, ideal for families with children.

items.name: Jumeirah Park
items.description:
Jumeirah park is a prestigious neighborhood in the heart of Dubai.
 It has parks, playgrounds, jogging paths and a community center with a variety of stores and services. Jumeirah Park offers a convenient and luxurious lifestyle in a vibrant environment.
 Jumeirah Beach and Kite Beach are nearby, and families with children can visit Legoland, Motiongate and Bollywood Parks theme parks. The Mall of Emirates shopping center is a 10-minute drive away, and the famous Dubai Miracle Garden and Dubai Butterfly Garden parks are 20 minutes away.
 The main types of real estate Jumeirah Park - villas, known for its spacious layout and modern design, and townhouses.

items.name: Jumeirah Second
items.description:
Jumeirah Second in Dubai is a prestigious residential community located along the Gulf Coast. The neighbourhood is renowned for its exclusive villas and luxury mansions that offer residents and visitors an exquisite level of comfort and privacy.
 Jumeirah Second attracts successful businessmen, celebrities and those who appreciate a luxurious lifestyle. Picturesque beaches, promenades, parks and gardens create a unique atmosphere of rest and relaxation. The area is also known for its wealth of entertainment and dining venues offering a diverse culinary culture.
 Residents of Jumeirah Second can enjoy beautiful panoramic views of the sea or city, as well as proximity to shopping centres, schools, medical facilities and other infrastructure. The area features proximity to historical landmarks and modern entertainment centres, making it a great place to live and relax.
 Jumeirah Second is the perfect blend of luxury, comfort and prestigious status, making it one of the most attractive neighbourhoods for those looking for high-end accommodation in Dubai.

items.name: Jumeirah Third
items.description: Jumeirah 3 is an area on the shores of the Persian Gulf, famous for its Burj El Arab hotel, made in the shape of a sail. There is also a Wild Wadi water park with water slides and wave pools. You can go kitesurfing or flyboard on the sandy Kite Beach, created by Meraas, as well as on a regular public beach. For a family holiday, Jumeirah Beach is suitable, equipped with barbecue facilities. Along the coast you can find many bars with outdoor tables, as well as restaurants with a relaxed atmosphere, where seafood dishes are served.

items.name: Layan Community
items.description: Layan Community is a premium residential development in Dubai, offering a tranquil and family-friendly environment with modern amenities and scenic surroundings. The community features a mix of villas, townhouses, and apartments designed with contemporary architecture, spacious layouts, and high-quality finishes. Residents enjoy landscaped parks, walking and cycling tracks, swimming pools, fitness centers, and retail facilities, providing a balanced lifestyle of comfort, leisure, and wellness. Strategically located with easy access to major roads and key destinations in Dubai, Layan Community is ideal for families, professionals, and investors seeking a peaceful yet well-connected neighborhood with long-term growth potential.

items.name: MBR City District 1
items.location: (D1) District One Residences (all buildings), Al Merkadh
items.description:
MBR District 1 is a luxurious and upscale neighborhood in Dubai, located in Mohammed Bin Rashid (MBR) City. This neighborhood is an exceptional premium community with exquisitely designed buildings and first-class amenities. It is known for its luxury, comfort and high level of service, attracting the most discerning clientele.
 The area offers a wide range of accommodation, including luxury villas and apartments with stunning views of the surrounding landscape and Dubai Waterfront. Residents enjoy spacious interiors, state-of-the-art technology, high security standards and privacy.
 MBR District 1 is also known for its active recreational areas. Luxury pools, high-end spas, fitness centers, world-class restaurants, and green parks and squares for strolling and relaxing can be found here.
 One of the key elements of the neighborhood's appeal is its well-appointed infrastructure. The district is provided with everything necessary for a comfortable life, including schools, kindergartens, medical facilities, shopping centers and convenient transportation routes.
 MBR District 1 is a district for those who appreciate status, luxury and comfort, as well as strive for the highest standard of living and service. Modern design, high quality construction and unique atmosphere make this district one of the most attractive places to live and relax in Dubai.

items.name: MBR City District 7
items.location: MAG City, Mohammed Bin Rashid City

items.name: MBR District 11 (Meydan South)
items.location: Mohammed Bin Rashid Al Maktoum District 11, Wadi Al Safa 3
items.description:
District 11, MBR is a prestigious residential area located on the outskirts of a growing neighborhood that will soon become the epicenter of Dubai.
 The neighborhood offers its residents a variety of amenities and activities. There is a private club for families as well as a local community center. Schools, kindergartens, medical facilities, stores, as well as numerous green spaces create an incredible atmosphere of calm and comfortable living.
 The main types of properties in the area are luxury villas and apartments with beautiful views and finished finishes.

items.name: MJL (Madinat Jumeirah Living)
items.location: Madinat Jumeirah Living (MJL), Um Suqaim Third
items.description:
Madinat Jumeirah Living is a residential complex with premium real estate. All buildings are made in the style of classical Arabian architecture. The neighborhood is suitable for those people who want to live by the sea and not to give up the conveniences of modern man. In addition to excellent infrastructure, the neighborhood has attractive views, lots of greenery and well-maintained areas for walking and recreation.
It is a beautiful and safe neighborhood to live in, the houses have security guards and video surveillance systems.
The neighborhood is well located - it is close to all the important points of Dubai. MJL is part of the larger Umm Suqeim neighborhood, with the Arabian Gulf close by. Nearby Madinat Jumeirah Living has a beach, shopping centers. From all parts of the neighborhood there is an attractive view of the city, the famous hotel in the shape of a sail. The whole area of the residential complex is connected by a pedestrian street, through it you can quickly get to any residential complex.

items.name: Madinat Hind 4
items.description: Madinat Hind 4 is a well-established residential community in Dubai, offering a family-friendly environment with convenient access to key city destinations. The area features a mix of apartments and villas, complemented by essential amenities such as schools, supermarkets, healthcare facilities, and retail outlets. Its strategic location provides easy connectivity to Al Nahda, Dubai International Airport, and Sheikh Mohammed Bin Zayed Road, making it ideal for daily commuting. Known for its quiet streets, practical infrastructure, and community-focused lifestyle, Madinat Hind 4 is a popular choice for families, professionals, and investors seeking a balanced and accessible neighborhood in Dubai.

items.name: Majan
items.description:
Majan is a modern residential community located in the Dubailand region, which is one of the largest and most diverse urban developments in Dubai. The Majan neighbourhood is ideal for family living due to its diverse infrastructure, comfortable living environment and convenient location.
  The neighbourhood offers a variety of property options, including apartments and villas, combining modern design and high quality construction. Residents can enjoy extensive green spaces, walking paths, playgrounds and sports facilities, creating a cosy and comfortable atmosphere for an active lifestyle.
 Shopping centres, restaurants, cafes, kindergartens and schools are located around Majan, making it a convenient place to live. There are also parks and gardens in the neighbourhood where residents can spend time outdoors, exercise or organise picnics with family and friends.
 Majan has good transport accessibility, which ensures easy travelling around the city and accessibility to infrastructure facilities. Its favourable atmosphere, variety of entertainment options and convenient location make it an attractive place to live in Dubai.

items.name: Maritime City
items.description:
Maritime City is a prominent coastal neighbourhood in Dubai that has been designed to meet the needs of the modern maritime industry and has become an important maritime hub in the region. Located on the Persian Gulf, the area offers extensive port facilities, exclusive maritime services and state-of-the-art infrastructure designed to the highest standards.
 Maritime City includes port terminals, shipyards, marinas, marine technology and service centres providing a full range of services for ships and yachts. There is a huge potential for maritime economic development, trade and transport, making the area strategically important for the development of the maritime industry in the region.
 Maritime City is also an attractive place for recreational activities due to its prime location on the bay and its well-developed infrastructure. Here you can enjoy beautiful sea views, stroll along the waterfront, visit restaurants and cafes overlooking the water, and enjoy water sports and activities.
 Designed to the latest safety and environmental standards, Maritime City promotes a sustainable maritime industry and preserves the marine environment. Innovative technologies and approaches have been introduced to enhance the working, leisure and living environment in this unique maritime complex.

items.name: Meydan (District One West)
items.location: District One West, Ghadeer Al Tair
items.description: District One West is the latest ultra-luxury residential community within Mohammed Bin Rashid Al Maktoum City (MBR City), developed by Meydan. Designed for those who seek exclusivity and elegance, the community features a stunning collection of 4 to 7-bedroom villas and mansions, surrounded by lush greenery, landscaped parks, and the iconic Crystal Lagoon—one of the largest man-made lagoons in the world.

items.name: Mina Rashid
items.location: Rashid Yachts And Marina, Mina Rashid
items.description:
Mina Rashid is a waterfront neighborhood located on the shores of historic Dubai Creek. 
 The convenient location provides easy access to Pearl Jumeirah Island, Downtown Dubai business districts, DIFC and Dubai International Airport all within a 20 minute radius. Major medical centers nurseries and schools can be reached within 10 minutes.
 The community offers a vibrant and luxurious lifestyle, providing residents with top-notch amenities and services and quick access to beaches. Another attraction is the huge cruise ship Queen Elizabeth II, which has been modernized and converted into a floating hotel.
 The main type of real estate in the area - apartment buildings, decorated in a modern style. The buildings are characterized by a chic design, created with the latest trends in architecture. The beautiful color palette blends perfectly with the serene environment, impressing every visitor to the community.

items.name: Mira Oasis
items.location: Reem - Mira Oasis Community Phase 1, Al Yelayiss 1
items.description: Mira Oasis is a modern residential community in Dubai, offering a tranquil and family-friendly environment with contemporary living spaces. The development features a range of townhouses and villas with stylish designs, spacious layouts, and high-quality finishes. Residents can enjoy landscaped gardens, parks, swimming pools, fitness centers, and retail facilities, providing a well-rounded lifestyle that balances comfort, leisure, and convenience. Strategically located with easy access to Dubai-Al Ain Road, major highways, and key destinations, Mira Oasis is ideal for families, professionals, and investors seeking a serene yet well-connected community in Dubai.

items.name: Mirdif
items.description:
Mirdif is a picturesque and attractive neighborhood in Dubai that offers its residents and visitors a cozy environment, comfort and a variety of opportunities for an active lifestyle. The neighborhood is located in the northeast of the city and is a popular place to live among locals and expats.
 The residential areas in Mirdif are characterized by a calm and quiet environment, making it an ideal place for families. A variety of accommodation can be found here, ranging from apartments and townhouses to spacious villas with gardens and swimming pools. The area is known for its good infrastructure including wide roads, stores, restaurants, schools, medical facilities and various recreational areas.
 One of the highlights in Mirdif is the modern shopping and entertainment center Mirdif City Centre, where you can enjoy shopping, visit cafes and restaurants, and spend time at the cinema or entertainment centers. There are also parks and squares in the area where you can enjoy nature, spend your leisure time and do sports.
 Mirdif is also famous for its unique architectural style, where modern buildings and residential complexes intertwine with traditional Arabian elements, creating an atmosphere of harmony and comfort. In addition, the area has a favorable ecological environment thanks to green areas and well-maintained landscapes.

items.name: Mudon
items.description: Mudon is a master-planned residential community in Dubai, designed to offer a serene and family-friendly lifestyle with modern conveniences. The development features a mix of townhouses and villas with contemporary architecture, spacious layouts, and high-quality finishes. Residents enjoy a variety of amenities including parks, cycling and jogging tracks, swimming pools, community centers, and retail outlets, creating a balanced environment for leisure, wellness, and everyday living. Strategically located with easy access to Al Qudra Road, Emirates Road, and major city destinations, Mudon provides a perfect combination of tranquility, connectivity, and investment potential, making it ideal for families and professionals seeking a well-rounded community in Dubai.

items.description:

items.name: Palm Jumeirah
items.description:
Palm Jumeirah - an artificial island in the shape of a palm tree created by Nakheel. The length of the coastline is 1500 kilometers. The trunk of the palm tree is its very center and is connected to the mainland of Dubai by a 300 meter long bridge. Here is located all the main infrastructure - cafes, restaurants, stores, as well as many entertainment venues. The crown of the palm is connected to 16 branches, on which are located elite villas and cottages with private beaches. At the top of the island there is a "crescent moon", which performs a protective function. On it are located hotels and resort complexes, including the famous five-star resort hotel Atlantis with its own sandy beach and a magnificent view of the Persian Gulf. All parts of the area are connected by highways, with a monorail running through the center. 
 Palm Jumeirah offers its residents a huge number of places to visit, such as a water park, Nakheel Mall, elite restaurants. Residents of villas, apartment complexes and hotels have access to private beaches, can take a boat trip around the island on a private yacht or stroll along the Palm Jumeirah Boardwalk or Palm West Beach. Also on the island is the world's largest dancing fountain Palm Fountain.
 The main types of real estate in the area are apartments and villas. Life here is ideal for families, young couples and people looking for a comfortable and luxurious life by the sea. Due to the popularity and developed infrastructure of the area investors can count on a stable income > 5-10% per year.

Ras Al Khor is an abundance of fish, crustaceans, and birds. This is one of the most important bird habitats on the planet, whose status is secured by the World Conservation Organization. Ras Al Khor is especially proud of its large population of pink flamingos, numbering 500 individuals.
 The industrial area includes auto-related businesses, such as service centers, car wash, vehicle repair and a few warehouses.
 Two international schools, grand green open spaces, an 18-hole golf course and many dining options are nearby.
 The Ras Al Khor Road with two interchanges provide access to the west and east of Dubai. A new metro line is also planned, providing access to Business Bay within 10 minutes.

items.name: Um Al Sheif
items.description:
Umm Al-Sheif (Arabic: الم الليي) is a locality in Dubai, United Arab Emirates (UAE).Umm al-Sheif is a small residential area in the west of Dubai. It is bordered on the north by Umm Suqaym, northeast by Al Manara, south by Al Barsha and Al Qouz b west by Al Sufuh. It is bounded to the north by the D 92 highway (Al Wasl Road) and to the south by the E11 route (Sheikh Zayed Road). A local road (Al Thaniya Road) separates Um al-Shaif from Al-Manara.

Umm al-Sheif is a developing, affluent residential complex with villas and townhouses. The system of local roads primarily corresponds to the grid plan, but residential settlements are usually divided into sections. Roads with even numbers run from northeast to southwest, and roads with odd numbers run from northwest to southeast. The Emirates International School is located in Umm al-Sheif.
